name: How long does a typical whole-house remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole-house remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-house remodel varies significantly based on the project's complexity, the size of your home, and the extent of changes. A minor remodel might take 4-6 months, while extensive structural changes or additions could extend to 12-18 months or more. Key factors include design finalization, permitting processes, material lead times, and the construction phase itself. We establish a detailed timeline at the outset to manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-house remodel typically takes 4-18 months, depending on the project's complexity, home size, and scope of changes.
